title: A Slower Training Week
story: Malik’s plan said he should run five kilometres, yet his knee felt stiff after the first lap. He cut the session short and walked the rest of the route rather than pushing through the pain. That evening he replaced speed work with gentle cycling and noted the change in his log. His coach agreed that a careful week was better than a long injury.

vocabulary.definition: Units used to measure a long distance.
Hard to bend and a little painful.

quiz.question: How did Malik finish the rest of the route?
options: He walked it
He ran it faster than planned
He cycled it immediately
He skipped it without telling anyone
quiz.explanation: After cutting the run short, he walked the rest of the route.
quiz.supportingSentence: He cut the session short and walked the rest of the route rather than pushing through the pain.

quiz.question: Why did Malik stop running so early?
options: His knee hurt and he refused to force it
He had already finished five kilometres
The coach had ordered a morning cycle
The log said the route was closed
quiz.correctAnswer: His knee hurt and he refused to force it
quiz.explanation: His knee felt stiff, and he chose not to push through the pain.
quiz.supportingSentence: He cut the session short and walked the rest of the route rather than pushing through the pain.

quiz.question: What does the coach’s remark suggest about this week?
options: Doing less now is wiser than risking a long injury
Malik should ignore stiffness next time
Speed work must happen every evening
A long injury has already happened
quiz.correctAnswer: Doing less now is wiser than risking a long injury
quiz.explanation: The coach agreed that a careful week was better than a long injury.
quiz.supportingSentence: His coach agreed that a careful week was better than a long injury.

quiz.question: What does stiff mean in this story?
options: Hard to move comfortably
Very fast for a short distance
Written down in a book
Easy and gentle on the body
quiz.explanation: Malik’s knee felt stiff after one lap, meaning it was uncomfortable to keep running on.
quiz.supportingSentence: Malik’s plan said he should run five kilometres, yet his knee felt stiff after the first lap.

quiz.question: Why did Malik note the change in his log?
options: So there was a record of the altered session
So the coach would add more speed work
So he could forget the pain
So the route would grow longer
quiz.correctAnswer: So there was a record of the altered session
quiz.explanation: He noted the change after replacing speed work with gentle cycling.
quiz.supportingSentence: That evening he replaced speed work with gentle cycling and noted the change in his log.
